summary: Immutep Limited, an Australian clinical-stage biotech listed on ASX and Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a development strategy update for eftilagimod alfa (efti). The filing addresses the root cause analysis following the early discontinuation of TACTI-004, identifying N-glycan structural differences between 200 L and 2,000 L manufactured efti. A new 200 L manufacturing run has been contracted, and future registration-directed development will focus on CPS 1 HNSCC and neoadjuvant soft tissue sarcoma, with study start targeted for 2H CY2027.
